decisionLog.outcome: Reset 2.2.2 under Andrew Wright, retiring the inherited delivery steps and resource assumptions and redrafting the proposition around partnership infrastructure, access funding, alumni and philanthropy. The proposition is now ready for informal stakeholder sense-check before formal Delivery design.

Rebased the recommended Core planning assumption for partnership infrastructure from £600,000 to £400,000 p.a. from 2027/28, while preserving Year 1 discovery and the requirement to produce lean, Core and more ambitious operating-model options from evidence. Student Opportunities Fund design remains within 2.2.2, but any new award pot is explicitly outside the King's Edge mobilisation ask and requires a separate institutional, consolidated-fund, philanthropic or other funding route.

decisionLog.forum: King's Edge Delivery Plan working update
decisionLog.outcome: Broaden 2.2.2 into Future-Proofed Employability & Experiential Infrastructure. Preserve the existing experiential partnership, access-funding, alumni and philanthropy work; add dedicated international employer-engagement, proactive graduate-transition and incremental global-mobility opportunity-development capability; and model the UK Experiential Partnerships & Opportunity Development investment from 2027/28 as four specified posts: 1 x G6 Experiential Partnerships & Opportunity Development Manager, 2 x G5 Experiential Opportunity Development Advisers and 1 x G5 Experiential Partnerships Operations & Intelligence Adviser. On the current fully loaded role-cost basis this remains £214,089 annualised, matching the fully developed international employer-engagement team. Andrew Wright leads the deliverable with Eleanor Hannan as co-lead. The international employer-engagement team is phased across the three delivery years: 1 x G6 in 2027/28, the East Asia G5 in 2028/29, and the remaining two G5 advisers in 2029/30. Graduate Transitions is deferred to September 2028, bringing the G7 Head and G6 Coach into the second cost year rather than 2027/28. Global Mobility opportunity-development capacity remains planned as 1 x G6 plus 1 x G5 from September 2027. All grade-based staffing figures are treated as fully loaded planning costs including employer National Insurance and pension/superannuation, subject to Finance/HR validation before approval. On the current role-cost basis, the annualised Core run-rate remains £431,082 in 2027/28, £609,584 in 2028/29 and £714,058 once fully mobilised in 2029/30, excluding any separately funded Student Opportunities Fund award pot. Given the scale, workforce specificity, cross-portfolio enabling role and recruitment/reputation benefits, 2.2.2 is also represented as its own fifth investment area in the portfolio investment case rather than being embedded as a generic partnership line inside Beyond-Course Opportunity and Participation.
